name: m365-copilot
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, in Teams, Office and the Microsoft 365 app: a chat assistant grounded in the signed-in user's own and shared Microsoft 365 work data and the public web. It answers, summarises and drafts in the conversation. It has no shell, no local filesystem, no browser it can drive and no local MCP servers. It changes other systems only through agents and connectors that an administrator or the user has added.

tools.m365: read the signed-in user's own and shared Microsoft 365 work data (what they can access): mail, calendar, meetings, Teams chats and channels they are in, files, people
tools.code_interpreter: run Python in a hosted sandbox on files uploaded to the chat
tools.ask_user: ask the user a question and read the answer in the conversation

lacks: running commands or scripts on the user's PC, and installing software
reading or writing files on the user's local disk
a browser that can click, fill forms or take screenshots
sending mail, forwarding or changing calendar events, posting chat messages, sharing or deleting files on the user's behalf without an added agent or connector
accounts, logins or credentials for external services other than the user's Microsoft 365 work account (GitHub, cloud providers, Dataverse)
MCP servers, agents or connectors other than the tools listed
